narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Exactly what Short John Mithril ordered!Here's ye' coin. I'd keep it clutched to your chest as ye' scuttle out of here, the arena combatants thirst for riches as much as they thirst for blood!
narrative.requestItemsText: Yarr, you be bringin' me my elixir?
